description: States a slide's claim as one dominant line, with an optional kicker naming the subject above it and a hairline closing the band.

data_schema.title: string (the claim)
data_schema.kicker: string (optional; the subject, set in type.kicker)
data_schema.variant: with_kicker | no_kicker (optional; with_kicker needs a kicker)
data_schema._id: instance id prefix, set by the slide

size_domain_emu.source: the size domain of the seed this component was ported from

variants.with_kicker: flex column: kicker, title, hairline. Chosen whenever the data carries a kicker.
variants.no_kicker: the same column without the kicker, for data that carries none. Never chosen to make a title fit.

variant_rule: the data decides: a kicker present gives with_kicker, absent gives no_kicker; the box never drops a kicker
single_line_rule: the kicker names a subject in a few words and must not wrap in any test box
